title: Sonny White at NASA Eagleworks claims Casimir-effect power
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sonny White at NASA Eagleworks claims Casimir-effect power, about recent at NASA Eagleworks, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
this guy Sunny White out here who's at
NASA Eagle Works and he claims that he
can power up 1.5 kilovolts microchip
with the Casemir effect

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that an engineer named Sonny White, who worked at NASA Eagleworks, a small NASA lab that explored far-out propulsion ideas, claims he can power a microchip at 1.5 kilovolts using the Casimir effect. The Casimir effect is a tiny force that appears between objects placed very close together, said to come from the energy of empty space itself. Michels raises it because, if true, it would mean energy could be drawn from empty space, an idea often linked to how UFOs might be powered.
